purpose: Bounded real-model CPU pilot for issues 174 and 178; no latency distribution claim
audio_source: tests/fixtures/2086-149220-0033.wav; short is one copy (7.435 s), long is ten copies (74.35 s), generated by tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.py
ws_connection_policy: Open each WS connection before starting the paired HTTP request; send the short WAV only after the long request's traced queue_wait event. Apply the same preconnection timing to idle controls.
amendment_1: After prereg commit 768eaad, the first mixed attempt opened WS after HTTP started and failed: the server log shows no WS handler admission until the 123.45 s long request completed, and the client received close 1001 pong timeout. The amended pilot measures an already connected dictation session. Preserve the failed new-session attempt separately; do not treat its missing final as a passing trial or a clean contention measurement. The material-contention rule and six-trial sequence are unchanged.
material_contention_rule: All three mixed WS finals match the idle short transcript; each mixed stop-to-final is at least 2 seconds and 2x longer than its paired idle run; each mixed run has at least one busy response; the long HTTP request completes successfully with at least two traced chunks; first short commit occurs before long completion. Anything else is inconclusive or no-go for this pilot.
reporting: Report all six per-trial wall times, busy retries, long request service and chunk counts, HTTP/WS errors, exact final-text equality, server/GGUF/audio hashes, CPU affinity, and host load. No p95/p99 with n=3. A positive pilot only supports further scheduling research, not a production default switch.
